description: Unique results/tooling copied (not moved) out of leftover E:/rd-wt worktrees (reorg3, ws-attn, ws-clean-int, ws-r3-evalstates3, ws-r3-hist, ws-r3-int, ws-r3-resid, ws-r3-score2, ws-wallc1 and small optional result files of ws-main2score, ws-brakefix, ws-entrieseval, ws-trainsetup, a9, dspeed-data, damping-snap) into the single work tree before the worktrees are removed. "old" is the original absolute path as ledger/docs cite it (both the E:/rd-wt and the historical D:/rd-wt spelling); "new" is repo-relative. Where one source file was copied to two places the secondary location is listed under "also". Tracked-on-branch files were written from the branch blob (git show, LF line endings); untracked files are byte copies. Skipped by design: *.pt checkpoints, nested .git, caches, _tmp junk, sensitive-named files (moved by a separate script), Drive-bound inputs (wallc1_inputs, es3 inputs/dev1, r3_box tars).
